{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Assessor'', this is ''Dorion Discus''. Ah, negative on customs inspection. We have a priority cargo for the Imperial base on Markon IV.|Roark Garnet attempts to bluff the Imperial Customs Frigate ''Assessor''|<ref name="RPG" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Markon IV]]. While attempting to evade a [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|customs]] inspection from the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] [[Assessor (Imperial Customs Frigate)|''Assessor'']], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] claimed to have a priority cargo for delivery to the base.<ref name="RPG" />
